# SolPulseData

> On-chain Solana market telemetry from verified Raydium V4 vault state. Computed telemetry and historical technical indicators only. Not financial, investment, or trading advice.

Base URL: https://solpulsedata.duckdns.org

Status: testing. Payment enforcement is not yet active. Paid routes are open for testing and will be enforced once legal review is complete.

## Free endpoints

- GET /health: service status and tracked assets
- GET /v1/sample: static schema example. Not live data.

## Paid endpoints (x402 v2, USDC on Solana)

- GET /v1/levels?symbol=SOL: price, floor, ceiling, RSI-14, SMA-200, dip score. Price 0.01 USDC.
- GET /v1/dipscan?min_score=60: verified assets in a dip zone, ranked. Price 0.02 USDC.
- GET /v1/cycle: Bitcoin halving timing estimate. Price 0.005 USDC.

## Method summary

Prices are read from Raydium V4 pool vaults after on-chain owner and mint checks. Hourly candles are recorded by the SolPulseData collector. RSI-14 needs 15 candles and SMA-200 needs 200 candles. Fields show null until warmup completes.

## Machine-readable files

- OpenAPI: https://solpulsedata.github.io/openapi.json
- x402 discovery: https://solpulsedata.github.io/.well-known/x402.json
- Terms: https://solpulsedata.github.io/terms.html
